product.olivetti-m4-p75-s.summary: The 75 MHz M4-P in the Slim Tin Box case of the EDO memory platform.
product.olivetti-m4-p75-s.history: Olivetti documented the professional M4-Pxx range on a platform shared with the PCS 51xx and 61xx.
product.olivetti-m4-p75-s.architecture: The case determines how many cards can be installed. The Slim Tin Box riser has 1 ISA, 1 PCI and one shared slot.
product.olivetti-m4-p75-s.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m4-p75-s.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m4-p75-s.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 16
product.olivetti-m4-p75-s.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists 1.21.
